words.example: The result is abnormal and needs a repeat test.
words.exampleZh: 結果反常，需要再驗一次。
words.notes: 反常的、不規則的。mentally abnormal 是精神失常。

words.example: Some patients abuse the cough syrup.
words.exampleZh: 有些病人濫用止咳糖漿。
words.notes: 濫用，也可指虐待。abuse sb 是虐待某人。

words.example: The active ingredient is listed first.
words.exampleZh: 起作用的成分寫在最前面。
words.notes: 起作用的、積極的、活躍的。

words.example: The addiction started with a legal prescription.
words.exampleZh: 成癮始於一張合法處方。
words.notes: 上癮、沉溺。drug addiction 是藥物成癮。

words.example: This cough syrup can be addictive.
words.exampleZh: 這種止咳糖漿可能容易上癮。
words.notes: 上癮的。addicted 是上癮的。addict 是上癮的人。

words.example: Alcohol wipes are by the sink.
words.notes: 酒精、乙醇。pure alcohol 是純酒精。

words.example: The two pills look alike.
words.exampleZh: 這兩顆藥丸看起來相像。
words.notes: 相像的。副詞是相似地。be alike in 是在某方面相像。

words.example: A cold pack can alleviate the swelling.
words.notes: 減輕、緩和。alleviate pain 是減輕疼痛。alleviate the burden 是減輕負擔。

words.example: This antibiotic is taken with food.
words.exampleZh: 這種抗生素要配食物吃。
words.notes: 抗生素。形容詞是抗菌的。antibiotic resistance 是抗藥性。

words.example: The board will ban that dye in syrups.
words.exampleZh: 委員會將禁售糖漿裡的那種色素。
words.notes: 禁止、禁忌。ban on 是對某事的禁止。

words.example: Change the bandage every morning.
words.notes: 繃帶。動詞是用繃帶包紮。apply a bandage 是上繃帶。

words.example: The tablet adds calcium.
words.notes: 鈣。calcium carbonate 是碳酸鈣。calcium oxide 是氧化鈣。

words.example: Swallow the capsule whole.
words.notes: 膠囊，也可指太空艙。soft capsule 是軟膠囊。

words.example: The cough is chronic.
words.notes: 慢性的。chronic disease 是慢性病。

words.example: She can cope with the side effects.
words.notes: 處理、對付。cope with 是應付。

words.example: This drug is for daytime use.
words.notes: 藥，也可指毒品。drug for 是治療某病的藥。

words.example: The drugstore closes at nine.
words.notes: 賣成藥的店，也可稱藥房。

words.example: The effect starts in about an hour.
words.exampleZh: 作用大約一小時後開始。
words.notes: 效果、作用。have an effect 是有作用。side effect 是副作用。

words.example: Few people endure the bitter taste twice.
words.exampleZh: 很少人忍受得了那種苦味第二次。
words.notes: 忍耐、容忍。endure the side effect 是忍受副作用。

words.example: A splinter is under the finger.
words.notes: 手指。point the finger at 是指責。

words.example: Cover the scrape with gauze.
words.notes: 紗布、紗綢。gauze swab 是棉質紗布。

words.example: This herb is sold as a tea.
words.notes: 草藥、香草。medical herb 是藥草。

words.example: The hypnotic made the night quieter.
words.exampleZh: 安眠藥讓這一夜安靜些。
words.notes: 安眠藥，也可指催眠的。hypnotic state 是催眠狀態。

words.example: Clean water is indispensable in the ward.
words.exampleZh: 病房裡乾淨的水不可或缺。
words.notes: 不可缺少的、必需的。essential 與 necessary 是近義。

words.example: The dose will inevitably change.
words.exampleZh: 劑量不可避免地會調整。
words.notes: 不可避免地、必然地。

words.example: Initially the rash was only on the arm.
words.notes: 最初、起先。originally 是起初。firstly 是首先。

words.example: Read the instruction before the first dose.
words.exampleZh: 第一次服藥前先讀用法說明。
words.notes: 用法說明、指導。常用複數 instructions。

words.example: Use lint if there is no gauze.
words.notes: 絨布、麻布。可用來包紮。

words.example: The medical record is incomplete.
words.notes: 醫學的、醫療的。medical research 是醫學研究。

words.example: Take the medicine after breakfast.
words.notes: 藥、醫學。動詞是給某人用藥。take medicine 是吃藥。

words.example: The medication lasts twelve hours.
words.exampleZh: 這次藥物治療維持十二小時。
words.notes: 藥物、藥物治療。oral medication 是口服藥。topical medication 是外用藥。

words.example: Shake the mixture before each dose.
words.exampleZh: 每次服用前先搖勻合劑。
words.notes: 合劑、混合。mixture ratio 是混合比例。

words.example: Morphine is locked in the cabinet.
words.notes: 嗎啡。morphine withdrawal 是嗎啡戒斷。

words.example: The nail is torn at the edge.
words.notes: 指甲，也可指釘子。動詞是釘住。

words.example: The ointment soothed the rash.
words.notes: 藥膏、軟膏。unguent 是藥膏。

words.example: Ordinarily one tablet is enough.
words.notes: 平常地、一般地。commonly 與 generally 是近義。

words.example: Do not overdo the exercise in week one.
words.exampleZh: 第一週的運動不要做得過火。
words.notes: 過度使用、做得過分。過去分詞常用 overdone。

words.example: An overdose needs emergency care.
words.notes: 用藥過量。drug overdose 是服藥過量。

words.example: The chart marks the child as overweight.
words.exampleZh: 這張表把孩子標成超重。
words.notes: 超重的、肥胖的。也可作名詞指超重。

words.example: Side effects can overwhelm a new patient.
words.exampleZh: 副作用可能使新病人難以承受。
words.notes: 使不知所措，也可指淹沒。

words.example: One painkiller is enough tonight.
words.notes: 止痛藥。strong painkiller 是強效止痛藥。

words.example: Refills need permission from the doctor.
words.notes: 許可、允許。without permission 是未經許可。

words.example: The pharmacist checked the dose.
words.notes: 藥劑師，也可指藥商。dispenser 是配藥員。apothecary 是舊稱藥劑師。

words.example: The pharmacy is on the ground floor.
words.notes: 藥房，也可指藥學。clinical pharmacy 是臨床藥學。

words.example: A pile of forms waits at the desk.
words.notes: 堆、大量。動詞是堆積。pile up 是堆起來。

words.example: The pill is scored down the middle.
words.notes: 藥丸。sleeping pill 是安眠藥。diet pill 是減肥藥。

words.example: The bottle is marked as poison.
words.notes: 毒藥、毒物。

words.example: That cleaner is poisonous if swallowed.
words.exampleZh: 那種清潔劑吞下去有毒。
words.notes: 有毒的。toxic 與 venomous 是近義。

words.example: The prescription is valid for thirty days.
words.exampleZh: 這張處方三十天內有效。
words.notes: 處方。prescription drug 是處方藥。

words.example: The label is prescriptive about meal times.
words.exampleZh: 標籤對用餐時間是硬性規定的。
words.notes: 指定的、規定的。specified 是規定的。

words.example: The ward rules prohibit outside food.
words.notes: 禁止、阻止。prohibit sb from doing 是禁止某人做某事。

words.example: The new plan differs radically from the old one.
words.exampleZh: 新計畫和舊計畫徹底地不同。
words.notes: 根本地、徹底地。thoroughly 是徹底地。completely 是完全地。

words.example: Sleep may regress when the dose drops.
words.exampleZh: 劑量下降時睡眠可能倒退。
words.notes: 退化、倒退。regression 是消退、倒退。

words.example: Relief came within the hour.
words.exampleZh: 緩解感在一小時內出現。
words.notes: 減輕、救濟。pain relief 是止痛。

words.example: This syrup can relieve a dry cough.
words.exampleZh: 這瓶糖漿可以緩解乾咳。
words.notes: 緩解、救濟。relieve pain 是減輕疼痛。

words.example: Quick care can save the limb.
words.exampleZh: 及時處理可以救活這肢。
words.notes: 挽救、節約。名詞可指救援。save a life 是救命。

words.example: Sedation is planned before the scan.
words.notes: 鎮靜、鎮靜劑。

words.example: The two rashes look similar.
words.notes: 相似的、類似的。similar to 是與某物相似。

words.example: The sore on the lip is small.
words.notes: 痛處，也可指潰瘍。形容詞是疼痛的。

words.example: Caffeine can stimulate the heart.
words.notes: 刺激、起作用。

words.example: A rash is the first symptom.
words.notes: 症狀、徵兆。symptom complex 是症候群。

words.example: The therapy runs for six weeks.
words.notes: 治療、療法。in therapy 是在接受治療。

words.example: The thermometer reads a high fever.
words.notes: 體溫計。resistance thermometer 是電阻溫度計。

words.example: This dose should not leave a child thin.
words.exampleZh: 這個劑量不該讓孩子變瘦。
words.notes: 瘦的，也可指稀的。

words.example: The throat is scratchy tonight.
words.notes: 喉嚨。sore throat 是喉嚨痛。

words.example: The treatment avoids surgery.
words.notes: 治療、療法。take treatment 是接受治療。

words.example: One vitamin is due at breakfast.
words.notes: 維生素。vitamin deficiency 是缺乏維生素。

words.example: Open wounds are vulnerable to dirt.
words.exampleZh: 開放性傷口對髒污很脆弱。
words.notes: 易受傷的、脆弱的。sensitive 是敏感的。

words.example: A healthy liver can withstand a short course.
words.exampleZh: 健康的肝臟承受得住一個短療程。
words.notes: 經受、耐得住。過去式是 withstood。tolerate 是忍受。
